visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a black strap dress and a black beaded choker, walks along an urban sidewalk at night. She smiles at the camera, holding a small white handbag. The setting is dimly lit with warm lights from nearby buildings. (2) She approaches a wooden entrance of a restaurant decorated with a festive wreath and multiple stickers including a 'Michelin 2022' emblem. She smiles playfully, peeking around the doorframe before entering the establishment. (3) The scene shifts to a series of close-ups of Japanese cuisine on a wooden table. Initial dishes include white fish sashimi garnished with green paste, small octopuses on a white plate, and assorted pickled vegetables like cucumber and radish. (4) The woman is shown in a medium close-up, using wooden chopsticks to eat. She expresses delight through squinted eyes and a thumbs-up gesture. Animated white bubbles and 'like' icons appear as overlays during her reaction. (5) Further shots showcase various cooked or seared seafood: grilled fish with charred skin, sea urchin sushi on rice, and a large shrimp. The lighting is bright and warm, characteristic of an indoor dining environment. (6) The woman continues tasting different items, including a bite-sized sushi roll with a rich yellow topping. She closes her eyes and chews enthusiastically. (7) The final phase shows a dessert set consisting of two dark grapes on skewers and a small blue bowl containing a scoop of ice cream topped with brown sugar syrup and crumbles.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天要帶大家去吃一間非常好吃的日本料理. (2) [Logo]: MICHELIN 2022. [Subtitle]: 叫做 TESSASSA. 我們一起進去看看吧. (3) [Subtitle]: 第一道是比目魚 超級好吃 超香的. [Variety]: 👍. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為我不敢吃生食 所以師傅都幫我炙燒過了. (5) [Subtitle]: 這是小章魚 這是師魚 這不知道是什麼魚但很好吃. (6) [Subtitle]: 尖魚 還有這個年糕夾烏魚子真的超好吃. (7) [Subtitle]: 還有這個忘記叫什麼了 吃下去有一個紫蘇葉的味道. (8) [Subtitle]: 不知道為什麼就是非常的順口 很好吃. (9) [Subtitle]: 第一次看到炙燒海膽也太可愛了吧. (10) [Subtitle]: 還有好大的蝦蝦 我的愛. (11) [Subtitle]: 聽說這是日本比賽第一名的生蠔. (12) [Subtitle]: 這是青魚 上面有一個不會辣的薑花. (13) [Subtitle]: 這是我今天最最最喜歡的一道 中間是鮪魚. (14) [Subtitle]: 上面是像糖心蛋的蛋黃 天吶也太好吃了吧. (15) [Subtitle]: 這是鮪魚的腹部 這是今天的最後一道壽司. (16) [Subtitle]: 玉子燒跟星鰻 全部吃光光. (17) [Subtitle]: 最後的甜點是水果 還有黑糖冰淇淋.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle food vlog where the creator shares her dining experience at 'TESSASSA', a Japanese restaurant. She highlights the Michelin recognition and provides a personal review of various seared seafood dishes, focusing on her preference for cooked over raw preparations.
